note: Coordinate-labelled review of the third draft (evidence/review3/*.png: HGSS left, installed native right). Native cells x,y. "fixed" findings were corrected before the reviewed build; "adaptation" ones are deliberate; "open" ones remain for owner review.

findings.finding: Lawn edges sat a cell low: ground came from the flat top-down decode while rock came from the true-height render, and HGSS's road01_r rim texture (half lawn) was classed as road. Ground now reads lawn/road per 8 px quadrant from the HGSS reference's own colours.
The narrow lawn strip between the mountain's east face and the gate-side face vanished when both face ends snapped to the tile grid. Ends facing ground narrower than 8 px now keep HGSS's pixels.
Ledge stub read as lawn (HGSS ledge stone pixels counted as lawn); ledge cells now read the ground the stone band leaves open. Road under it, as HGSS.
Stray road squares inside the south lawn from quadrants with a few sand-coloured rim pixels; a quadrant now needs half its pixels in road sand.
Single-pixel role steps at rock joins and mesh-hole fills; isolated pixels take their neighbours' role.

Two rear rims back to back (terrace rim, then a pillar's) were resampled as one 14 px course and read as a front face; they are now two courses. Rear rims use R02's own lower course (the dark band HGSS shows from above) instead of a mirrored, squeezed face.
House window glass merged into the wall cream during palette reduction; cool and warm tones no longer merge.
Souvenir-shop plaque and Gym marker sat 8 and 16 px below HGSS's sign bases; raised to HGSS's base rows.
T01, the approved shared tree, is 48 px tall on HGSS's 2x2 roots; HGSS's bushes are 32 px. Crowns rise one row higher and cover a little of the walls behind them (cells 5-8,4-5).
C06 is shorter than HGSS's Center; the road shows where HGSS's taller roof stood. Those cells are walkable, the only collision change from HGSS.
G01a, the approved front gatehouse, at cell (10,-2): its door column on HGSS warp (13,5). Its top two rows are off the map, as HGSS's gate runs into Route 43. Warps solid until the gatehouse exists.

Rock faces use one 16 px course per orientation (R02 front, R12 side) and a 16 px plateau-top core, the Routes 31/32 structure rebuild's capacity method; rock edges meeting ground snap to the 8 px tile grid (shift up to 4 px).

Local HGSS masters moved to the nearest 8 px tile corner (2-3 px) and reduced: houses and towers share 14 tones (from 45), antenna tree 13 (from 24), Gym 19 (from 37, the fewest merges that fit two banks). Shapes unchanged.
Lawn/road rims run straight on the 8 px grid (no 32 px wave) and the road repeats a 16 px core, to fit 1,008 tiles.
Two open lawn cells behind the west tower are enclosed by walls and the tower, unreachable on foot. This is HGSS's own collision, kept unchanged.
The west mountain's short side face beside the tower reads as a plain slab; HGSS shows a sloped surface there. Partly behind T01 crowns.
